raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Rows from collector 'v2' have timestamps about 6 hours ahead of the true time. v2 rows start at 12:00 while legacy rows start at 06:00, and rows in a batch carry timestamps after the batch's own ingest time (e.g. 04:49 on 01-19 in a batch ingested at 02:00). Evening v2 transactions therefore roll past midnight into the next date, which explains the 00:00-06:00 spikes and the 36-row 2026-01-19. The fix subtracts 6 hours from v2 txn_ts in silver; the gold tables are rebuilt from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
